source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique in-band Get SEL Entry identity.

source_snapshot.procedure: Send raw 0x0a 0x43 with zero reservation bytes, a selected SEL record ID, offset zero and length 0xff; generic log clear.
source_snapshot.criteria: Command should be sent without any error.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES but substitutes unbounded sel list for the exact raw single-record request.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE with valid reservation/session, record selection and standard/OEM parser.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: Reserve SEL supplies a token but is separate coverage; Add/Delete/Clear cases must not be invoked.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-34 record ID/schema are Project inputs; ED-38 no retry.

original_test_intent: Read one identified SEL record and validate its protocol and decoded event fields without changing SEL contents.
original_method: Use Storage 0x0a/0x43 with validated reservation, record ID, offset and length.
manual_activity: Engineer approves record-selection and parser policy once; no per-run approval is needed for a bounded read.
safety_requirements: Do not substitute unbounded sel list
Reject stale reservation or ambiguous record ID

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Does not prove the Master raw request: sel list enumerates broadly and hides exact reservation/ID/offset/length semantics.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected raw 0x0a/0x43 with exact bytes, a same-session valid reservation where required, and a pinned record decoder.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Master placeholder and timing are preserved; values are supplied only from approved inputs.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Select one valid record, validate reservation/ID/offset/length, parse next-record and record payload fields including OEM handling, and prove non-mutation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Removes destructive clearing and unbounded listing substitution, while adding exact protocol acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One record read does not validate enumeration completeness, insertion, deletion or clearing.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong record selection or OEM parsing can misattribute a platform fault.

project_override_considerations: High-level SEL APIs may satisfy content-read coverage only if the exact record identity and equivalent fields/errors are traceable; they do not automatically validate raw 0x0a/0x43 behavior.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master clears evidence and uses zero reservation bytes without defining validity; Criteria checks only transport. DeepSeek substitutes broad sel list output and hides the requested raw-record semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The protocol operation is explicit. Reservation need, record ID and parser schema are Project readiness inputs and can be supplied without changing the Master.

review_improvement: Defines exact record identity and protocol/parser checks while preventing destructive or broader substitutes.
independent_technical_reasoning: A single SEL entry read has bounded deterministic request and response fields; with a valid token and pinned decoder it is FULLY AUTOMATABLE, while any mutation remains out of scope.

source_provenance.history: Reserve/adjacent SEL cases and prior review searched
